authorization_instruction: continue from here to as far as you can. dont stop for reports. you know i trust in your recommendations. complete the bootstraps if possible. but if you absolutely require my input for something thats a design choice that hasnt been decided yet, then defer it and build around it - if possible.

authoring.title: The certified registry separates protective and core contact roles
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR11.0 fixtures, the strict registry seals one protective-distal role and one core-impact role, classifies only observed semantic ground contacts, rejects duplicate identities, self or creature contacts, missing core role, and guidance authority, while the pure controller requests finite paired hinge torque only during FALL_ARREST, preserves exact finite PD arithmetic, has no mutation authority, and fails closed on nonfinite observation, unknown phase, or digest mutation.
authoring.scope: Only the exact role registry, ground qualification, finite controller configuration, structural torque ceiling, digest identities, source, and BR11.0 program scope certified by br11_20260723T195911Z_d4551f99.
authoring.mechanism: Observed ground contacts are assigned immutable protective-distal or core-impact semantics. A separate pure controller maps one finite FALL_ARREST observation into a bounded paired hinge request and performs no physics mutation itself.
applicability: Checking semantic protective and core contact-role separation at the certified registry
Checking pure finite hinge-request behavior and strict refusal outside FALL_ARREST
failure_boundaries: Role classification is an observation contract and does not create or retain physical contact
A finite requested torque is not proof of injury avoidance, arbitrary strength, or generalized load allocation
No upright recovery, free 3D standing or bracing, generalized fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, repair, or guidance is established
unknowns: How protective and core roles should generalize across arbitrary creature morphology and terrain
How controller gains and structural ceilings should be calibrated without turning commands into measurements

authoring.title: The certified supervisor requires observed fall-arrest preconditions
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR11.1 fixtures, the strict observation-authoritative supervisor enters FALL_ARREST only when upright recovery is infeasible, impact is imminent, and protective capacity is available; grants no force, torque, repair, or guidance authority; requires consecutive stable observations before FALLEN; resets that dwell on instability; rejects duplicate or nonmonotonic ticks; names missing capacity honestly; and permits a zero-capacity control to become observably fallen without manufacturing an arrest claim.
authoring.scope: Only the exact phase set, observation fields, imminence and capacity semantics, stable-FALLEN dwell, tick ordering, source, and BR11.1 program scope certified by br11_20260723T195911Z_d4551f99.
authoring.mechanism: A strict supervisor changes phase only from explicit ordered observations. It distinguishes an eligible protective response from an observed stable fallen terminal state and never applies mechanics commands.
applicability: Checking the certified observation preconditions for entering FALL_ARREST
Checking stable-FALLEN dwell, reset, tick-order, and missing-capacity behavior
failure_boundaries: Supervisor phase authority does not prove that a controller can create a protective contact
Observed FALLEN is a terminal mechanics classification and not upright recovery or getting up
No free 3D standing or bracing, generalized fall arrest, gait, walking, repair, or guidance is established
unknowns: How imminence and protective-capacity observations should transfer across morphology and terrain
Which stable-terminal thresholds remain valid after releasing the planar scaffold

authoring.title: The certified oracle keeps controlled-fall mechanics channels explicit
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR11.2 fixtures, the digest-bound paired oracle derives preregistered active-to-control comparisons from whole-system kinetic energy, whole-system linear momentum, core approach speed, and an explicitly local core-load witness while retaining finite centroidal angular momentum, reconstructed external impulse, actuator work, contact dissipation, and energy residual channels. It rejects absent or nonfinite channels, false injury or allocation semantics, energy-accounting violations, late protection, missing core contact, unimproved declared measures, mismatched initial states, hidden control work, unstable terminal motion, and missing FALLEN transition.
authoring.scope: Only the exact paired summary schema, identities, thresholds, comparison ratios, accounting channels, non-claims, source, and BR11.2 program scope certified by br11_20260723T195911Z_d4551f99.
authoring.mechanism: The oracle recomputes the preregistered paired mechanics comparisons and reconciles finite momentum, impulse, actuator, dissipation, and residual witnesses without treating a local predicted contact impulse as generalized allocation.
applicability: Checking the certified paired controlled-fall mechanics comparison boundary
Checking explicit momentum, impulse, actuator-work, contact-dissipation, and energy-residual accounting
failure_boundaries: The kinetic-energy severity proxy is a mechanics comparison and not an injury prediction or tolerance model
The local predicted core-load witness is not measured per-contact, per-body, per-foot, or per-toe allocation
An oracle result does not establish free 3D standing or bracing, generalized fall arrest, upright recovery, getting up, gait, walking, repair, or guidance
unknowns: Which validated injury model, if any, should consume mechanics observables in a separate future evidence family
How external support loads could be allocated among multiple contacts without summing transmission-blind local impulses

authoring.title: The certified planar fixture creates protective contact before core impact
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR11.3 Godot/Jolt pair, the active finite paired hinge creates semantic protective contact before semantic core impact while the same-state zero-command control reaches core impact first; the active world improves the preregistered pre-core whole-system kinetic-energy proxy, core approach speed, local core-load witness, and whole-system linear-momentum comparisons; both worlds preserve finite angular momentum, explicit impulse and energy accounts, complete paired receipts, and stable FALLEN terminal states; and neither records upright recovery, root rescue, pinning, teleport, generalized allocation, injury semantics, or automatic guidance.
authoring.scope: Only the exact material planar guide, two-body morphology, semantic contact roles, initial state, surface, controller, supervisor, finite actuator, thresholds, timing, timestep, solver, engine, source, and BR11.3 program scope certified by br11_20260723T195911Z_d4551f99.
authoring.mechanism: One finite paired hinge deploys a protective distal link in the active world. The matched control executes the same scaffold and initial state with zero command. The analyzer compares preregistered pre-core mechanics channels and observes both complete stable-FALLEN horizons.
applicability: Checking one scaffold-constrained planar protective fall against its same-state zero-command control
Checking semantic contact order, finite actuation, paired receipts, mechanics comparisons, and stable-FALLEN completion
failure_boundaries: The material guide locks out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw, and its reaction is not measured or shown negligible
The kinetic proxy is not an injury model and the local predicted core-load witness is not generalized load allocation
The result ends FALLEN rather than upright and does not establish free 3D standing or bracing, generalized fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, creature repair, or automatic guidance
unknowns: Whether the response remains beneficial after releasing out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw
How different morphologies, terrains, fall directions, contacts, disturbances, and actuator limits alter the paired comparisons
What independently certified capabilities are required before any self-righting or getting-up controller can begin
